```{r}
source("R/07_add_light_treatment.R")

data_full <- readRDS('data_full.rds')

data_env <- data_env %>%
  left_join(
    lighting %>% select(date, color, intensity, block),
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    color     = if_else(year %in% c(2021, 2023) & is.na(color), "R", color),
    intensity = if_else(year %in% c(2021, 2023) & is.na(intensity), 75, intensity),
    block     = if_else(year %in% c(2021, 2023), "zero", block),
    color     = factor(color),
    site      = factor(site),
    block     = factor(block)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(intensity), !is.na(color))

data_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(
    control_year     = year %in% c(2021, 2023),
    switching_interval = case_when(
      control_year        ~ "control",
      block == "three"    ~ "three",
      block == "seven"    ~ "seven"
    ),
    switching_interval = factor(switching_interval,
                                levels = c("seven", "three", "control"))
  )
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# ── SPECIES MODELS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# =============================================================================
 
species_list <- unique(data_env$species)
cat("Fitting models for", length(species_list), "species...\n")
 
sp_formula <- detections ~ jd + I(jd^2) + mean_phase + pct_nonforest +
  intensity * color + mean_brightness_site + switching_interval + (1|year) + (1 | site)
 
fit_sp <- function(dat, sp) {
  # Attempt 1: default nlminb
  mod <- tryCatch(
    glmmTMB(sp_formula, family = nbinom2, data = dat),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  # Attempt 2: BFGS if Hessian not positive-definite
  if (is.null(mod) || !isTRUE(mod$sdr$pdHess)) {
    mod <- tryCatch(
      glmmTMB(sp_formula, family = nbinom2, data = dat,
              control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim,
                                       optArgs   = list(method = "BFGS"))),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }
  if (is.null(mod) || !isTRUE(mod$sdr$pdHess))
    cat("  WARNING:", sp, "— convergence uncertain after both optimizers\n")
  mod
}
 
sp_models <- list()
 
for (sp in species_list) {
  dat_sp <- data_env |> filter(species == sp)
 
  if (sum(dat_sp$detections) < 30 | nrow(dat_sp) < 20) {
    cat("  Skipping", sp, "— insufficient data\n")
    next
  }
 
  cat("  Fitting:", sp, "\n")
  sp_models[[sp]] <- fit_sp(dat_sp, sp)
}
 
sp_models <- sp_models[!sapply(sp_models, is.null)]
cat("Successfully fit:", paste(names(sp_models), collapse = ", "), "\n")

```

```{r}
# ── Extract emmeans summaries for all species ─────────────────────────────────
extract_color_intensity <- function(mod, sp_name) {
  tryCatch(
    as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ color | intensity,
                          at = list(intensity = c(10, 50, 100)),
                          type = "response")) |> mutate(species = sp_name),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

extract_slopes <- function(mod, sp_name) {
  tryCatch(
    as.data.frame(emtrends(mod, ~ color, var = "intensity")) |>
      mutate(species = sp_name),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

extract_color_main <- function(mod, sp_name) {
  tryCatch(
    as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ color, type = "response")) |>
      mutate(species = sp_name),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

df_sp_ci    <- map2_dfr(sp_models, names(sp_models), extract_color_intensity)
df_slopes   <- map2_dfr(sp_models, names(sp_models), extract_slopes)
df_sp_color <- map2_dfr(sp_models, names(sp_models), extract_color_main)
```

```{r}
# ── Fig S3: Color × intensity curves faceted by species ───────────────────────

  tryCatch(
    ggpredict(mod, terms = c("intensity [10:100 by=2]", "color")) |>

fig_s3 <- ggplot(pred_sp_list,

  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +

    subtitle = "Per-species GLMM marginal predictions",
    x        = "Light intensity (% of maximum)",
    y        = "Predicted detections per night",

  ) +
```

```{r}
# ── Fig S4: White:red ratio heatmap ───────────────────────────────────────────
df_heat <- df_sp_ci %>%
  select(species, color, intensity, response) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = color, values_from = response) %>%
  mutate(
    log2_ratio = log2(W / R),
    intensity  = factor(intensity, levels = c(10, 50, 100),
                        labels = c("Low (10%)", "Mid (50%)", "High (100%)"))
  )

fig_s4 <- ggplot(df_heat,
                  aes(x = intensity,
                      y = fct_reorder(species, log2_ratio, .fun = mean),
                      fill = log2_ratio)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(log2_ratio, 2)),
            color = "white", size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = col_red, mid = "#F5F5F5", high = col_white,
                       midpoint = 0, name = "log₂(White/Red)") +
  labs(
    title    = "White vs. Red Light Effect by Species and Intensity",
    subtitle = "Negative values (red) = white light suppresses relative to red",
    x        = "Light intensity", y = NULL,
    caption  = "log₂ ratio of predicted detections: white ÷ red"
  ) +
  bat_theme +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "right")

fig_s4
```

```{r}
data_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(block = factor(block, levels = c("three", "seven", "zero")))

# ── Fig C3: Block × color — overall ──────────────────────────────────────────
data_env %>%
  group_by(block, color) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_det = mean(detections, na.rm = TRUE),
    se       = sd(detections, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(block, mean_det, color = color, group = color)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_det - se, ymax = mean_det + se), width = 0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(R = col_red, W = col_white),
                     labels = c(R = "Red", W = "White"), name = "Light color") +
  labs(
    title    = "Mean Bat Activity by Block and Light Color",
    subtitle = "Raw means ± SE",
    x        = "Block", y = "Mean detections per night"
  ) +
  bat_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
    subtitle = "Raw means ± SE",

  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 9)
```
